Subject: Azure marketplace private offer — bundled SKU passback & overage credit

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We are finalizing an Azure private offer that bundles your inference credits with a managed-support SKU from CloudWave. A couple of items we need to lock down before procurement can approve:

- How do you represent reseller passback in the PO so Azure still shows the list price but CloudWave receives a "passback" for their margin?
- Can we get an overage credit structure (monthly reconciliation) instead of up-front list-price discounts?
- Any constraints on reporting/audit logs for channel splits (CloudWave will need evidence for their audit team).

We have an internal procurement cutoff on 11/16 — would love a short proposal we can attach to the PO. Happy to jump on another quick call.

Thanks,
Rami Shah

CloudWave Solutions

Hi Rami — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (channel/marketplace ops) and Ben (pricing) to propose a structure. Quick, high-level answers while we draft a short proposal:

- Passback: we can publish the full list price on Azure and use a reseller passback in the private-offer settlement that routes a fixed percentage (or fixed USD per unit) to CloudWave. That remains invisible on the customer invoice but is recorded in marketplace settlement reports.

- Overage credits: we can set an overage credit mechanism where CloudWave is reconciled monthly and issue credits for usage above committed tiers. That requires an agreed reconciliation cadence and an invoice/credit memo workflow.

- Audit evidence: we can provide monthly settlement reports and a signed statement of passback terms. For deeper audits (SOC2-style), we can provide exportable logs and the PO record.

Ben/Karthik — can you propose two simple options (A/B) for margin/passback mechanics and a sample math table for a $500k ARR bundled PO? Rami — I will aim to get a one-page proposal back by EOD 11/12.

Best,
Aisha
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Azure marketplace private offer — bundled SKU passback & overage credit

Thanks Aisha. Rami — quick notes from marketplace ops: 

Option A — List-price + percentage passback
- Private offer lists full retail on Azure.
- Settlement: Azure pays Redwood the list revenue; Redwood issues a monthly passback payment to CloudWave equal to X% of list revenue (we can set sliding band by tier).
- Pros: Simple to reconcile with Azure settlement files.
- Cons: Passback is on list which inflates the nominal passback amount if you care about net economics.

Option B — Net-revenue allocation + overage credits
- Private offer lists retail, but Redwood retains a portion as a reseller rebate to CloudWave off the top via settlement adjustments. Overage credit: if monthly usage exceeds committed tier, Redwood issues a credit to CloudWave for Y% of the overage amount.
- Pros: Better for predictable channel margin; credits reduce exposure to unexpected spikes.
- Cons: Requires a short reconciliation playbook (we can provide a one-page SOP).

Operational ask: need CloudWave's required reporting fields (partner ID, tax info) and the desired passback cadence (monthly vs quarterly). Laura — can you attach the standard marketplace settlement CSV spec to the proposal?

— Karthik
Head of Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi all — attached is a short proforma and worked example for a $500k ARR bundled PO (RW_Azure_PO_Deal_Model.xlsx). Summary highlights:

- Option A (percentage passback): 12% passback to CloudWave on list; monthly settlement. Net to Redwood after passback: $440k (example numbers in sheet).
- Option B (overage-credit model): 8% baseline passback + 60% credit on incremental overage above committed tier; reduces expected gross passback by ~20% in modeled usage profiles.

Notes / asks for CloudWave procurement:
1) Confirm which option they prefer and provide partner payout details for the vendor onboarding in Azure.
2) Confirm whether they require invoice-level passback records (we can provide aggregated settlement + line-item mapping).

Attachments: RW_Azure_PO_Deal_Model.xlsx (calculation model, stub)

Ben Carter
Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference
